LESSON: WOOD WORKSHOP

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: WOODWORK
Strand: Foundations of Woodworking
Topic 1.2: Wood Workshop
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Wood Workshop, part of Foundations of Woodworking in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 WOODWORK.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to have specific features in a wood workshop? 2. Why should a wood workshop have a proper layout?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Wood Workshop together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: learner develops speaking, listening, and teamwork skills when brainstorming

features of the workshop and discussing safety measures.

● Digital Literacy: learner develops digital skills when interacting with and manipulating digital devices to search for

features of a wood workshop.

Values:
● Respect: Learners appreciate diverse opinions of others as they discuss reasons for observing safety in the wood

workshop.

● Unity: learners visit workshops as a team in the school and neighbourhood to identify different features of wood

workshops.

● Patriotism: learner promotes good safety practices in the work environment.

Pertinent Contemporary Issues (PCs)

● Safety and security: learners observe safety for self and others in the workshop and road.

● Social cohesion: learner visit workshops in the school and community to identify different features

Suggested learning resources: adapted digital devices, charts, pictures, personal protective equipment.
